title: Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 51a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.51a.12), Rabbah bar bar Chanah said, “Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar told me: once I entered after Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakunya,” etc. In [Shabbat 49b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.49b.7), the name is Rabbi Yonatan.

notes.text: The consulted Pesachim paragraph explicitly names Rabbah bar bar Chanah. The previous expansion of רבב״ח as Bivi bar Abaye is withdrawn; the unquoted continuation is not inserted.
In the consulted Pesachim passage Yohanan ben Elazar enters after Shimon. Shabbat 49b has Yonatan beRabbi Elazar reporting Shimon in a differently framed passage.

Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakunya appears in both passages. In [Pesachim 51a:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.51a.12), Yochanan tells of following him into a garden. In [Shabbat 49b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.49b.7), Yonatan cites him in a discussion of the categories of Shabbat labor.
